headline: Ja'Marr Chase Drops 55, Hot Cocks Drops Pants
subhead: Week 10 was a bloodbath — three teams lost by 40+ and Put an AR to My Head finally found a use for the trigger.
matchOfTheWeek: Hot Cocks didn't just beat LargestofRocks, they performed an autopsy. 173.68 with 100% lineup efficiency, anchored by a 55-burger from Ja'Marr Chase, while LargestofRocks left 39 points rotting on the bench like groceries in a hot car. Will Levis and Rachaad White combined for 38 points in street clothes — congrats on starting the wrong half of your roster.
powerRankingsShakeup: Hot Cocks and The Olave Garden are flexing like they own the deed to the league, while Put an AR to My Head is currently the title of an autobiography. LargestofRocks is freefalling with the worst lineup-setting performance of the week.
mainRecap:
Where do we even start. 226 Alpha hung 149 on Bo Nix Celli and it still felt merciful — Bijan went for 29.4 and MVS dropped a random 25.9 for Celli and he STILL got beat by 43. When your RB1 and a Cowboys WR ghost combine for 55 and you lose by two scores, the problem is the other six guys you trotted out. Meanwhile Russell Wilson put up 19 on Szara's bench and nobody cared because Hurts went for 30 anyway. That's champagne-problem energy.

The Olave Garden put Put an AR to My Head out of its misery 150-98, with Burrow (33.72) and Kelce (24.40) doing the heavy lifting. Kyle, buddy — Derek Carr scored 20.46 on your bench. DEREK. CARR. The man who's been benched in real life was beating your starters. That's a special kind of pain.

The Good Ladds rode Kyler Murray's 28.74 to take down MassiveCocks, who continue to live up to a name that promises more than it delivers. T swift's Baddies snuck past OnlyFants behind a vintage 32.9 from Lamar — Cubby came within 16 but couldn't close, which is on-brand.

Jets' Juniors and Stroud Boys played the ugliest game of the week, a 118-98 slap fight where Calvin Ridley (25.4) was the only person who showed up with a pulse. Stroud Boys left John Metchie and his 18.4 on the bench — starting a Texans receiver who isn't Metchie right now is a war crime. Bjewett, you good?

And LargestofRocks. 161.5 optimal, 122.3 actual. Chuba went OFF for 24.9 and you still found a way to hand Hot Cocks a 51-point win because you couldn't decide which QB to start. Pick a guy. Any guy. Close your eyes.
